## Summary

Brief description of the vulnerability or security concern.

## Affected component

[e.g. policy engine, adapter execution, API server, UI, CLI]

## Impact

What an attacker could gain (privilege, scope escape, data exposure, etc.).

## Reproduction / proof of concept

Steps or code demonstrating the issue, if safe to share publicly.
